name: sairo-e2ee-chat
description: SAIRO — Modern, soothing, zero-registration end-to-end encrypted chat built on the MERN stack

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,green "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client run preview"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
